chat.json.notes: v1 Chat Completions (POST {endpoint}/openai/v1/chat/completions). Usage numbers are Microsoft's prompt-caching example (prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and cache_write_tokens; audio_tokens null). OpenAI semantics: prompt includes cache reads/writes, completion includes reasoning.

chat.sse.notes: stream_options.include_usage: an additional chunk with choices [] carries the whole-request usage before data: [DONE]; every other chunk has usage null (Azure v1 reference ChatCompletionStreamOptions).

chat.interrupted.sse.notes: Stream cut before the usage chunk: 'If the stream is interrupted, you may not receive the final usage chunk'.

deployments-chat.json.notes: Microsoft's documented chat completion example response; prompt_tokens_details and completion_tokens_details are optional (Required: No) and absent here, so the cache split is unknown.

responses.json.notes: POST {endpoint}/openai/v1/responses; OpenAI.ResponseUsage: input_tokens, input_tokens_details.cached_tokens (required), output_tokens, output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens (required), total_tokens.

responses.sse.notes: Usage on the response.completed event (OpenAI.ResponseCompletedEvent carries the OpenAI.Response).
